definition: G-20c KEEPER (promoted 2026-07-07, owner: 'if it's better promote it'; supersedes nyiso-53-li-tsl). Determination CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS. nyiso-53 recipe VERBATIM (nyiso_li_lcr_tsl #1345 + use_plant_emission_rates_v2 + downstate CT gas basis + energy_reserve_coopt) with ONE change: the LP now dispatches on MEASURED per-zone hourly load shapes instead of the static Gold-Book shares. load_zonal_shares gained a raw-file fallback (eia_loader) so the measured NYISO 'pal' actual-load (data/raw/zone-specific-demand/NYISO, upload U3) drives every zone's own diurnal/seasonal shape even when the gitignored data/clean parquet is absent — rule-12 measured>estimate, forward-reproducible, no new free parameter. Static shares understated the downstate peak (NYC 0.28 static vs 0.34 measured at peak; LI 0.12 vs 0.17) and forced every zone to peak the same hour, so the import-constrained NYC/SENY pocket never tightened. RESULT (G-20c): with measured load the downstate pocket BINDS and the in-LP locational reserve co-opt fires — 2023 NYC/Hudson LBMP spikes to $1,684 while Upstate maxes at $152 (genuinely locational). C3c tail vs RT actual: 2023 21h vs 10h (was 0h), 2025 14h vs 42h; C3a mean 2023 +1.6% vs DA (was -9.0%), C3b NRMSE 0.188/0.200/0.165 (keeper 0.182/0.221/0.190); C1/C2/C4 PASS, C7 PASS, no load-bearing regression. OPEN: 2024 (mild year) + 2025 deep >$300 tail still under — next lever is downstate import discipline (measured NYC locality import limit 2,875 MW < model Dunwoodie 3,900 MW estimate, apply in-window like #1345). C3c FAILs the DA-expressible gate (DA actual 1h) = the G-20a scoring-basis artifact, not an RT over-fire. C8 ST_GAS breach is the keeper's owner-held-legitimate G-05 item at LOWER forced share (30/45/38% vs keeper 61/70/60%) — kept+disclosed in the attestation. Governance ATTESTED; registered zero-forcing ablation twin. It dominates nyiso-53 on measured faithfulness (rule 12) + C3a/C3b with no load-bearing regression.
market_story: The keeper vs its zero-forcing twin isolates what the measured load shares buy on top of the merchant floors. The one change from nyiso-53 is a measured-data source swap (static Gold-Book -> measured per-zone hourly load shapes), which adds no floor and no free parameter, so the twin delta is dominated by the same PR-#1442 windowed downstate temperature ramps the nyiso-53 twin already characterised. What the measured shares change is WHERE the load sits: putting the true ~34% NYC / ~17% LI peak share into the LP (vs the flat 0.28/0.12 static) tightens the import-constrained NYC/SENY pocket, so the in-LP locational reserve co-opt fires and the downstate LBMP tail forms ($1,684/MWh in 2023, Upstate flat at $152) - real locational scarcity a NYCA-aggregate load allocation cannot produce, and it also LOWERS ST_GAS floor-forcing (30/45/38% vs 61/70/60%) because more of the downstate steam base now clears economically under the correct local load.
